contract_inferred: No 00-contract.md. Inferred from the page: web, Persuade with a Read part (a landing page for a self-hosted family AI app, with a feature grid, a screenshot gallery, download buttons and an installation guide in tabs), English only (html lang en at every width), no market named. No right-to-left language.
overall_reason: Cards and the installation steps wrap well at every width, but the page is blank without script, hides 60% of its text until an observer fires, and serves 1,200px screenshots as 124px thumbnails.

score.reason: T-NO-SCRIPT fails completely on a landing page (ROB-015, citing the sweep's ROB-001 Floors) and T-WEIGHT-FOR-JOB warns on unresized gallery images and a 486 KiB script (ROB-018), while T-WIDTHS and T-HOSTILE-CONTENT pass.

findings.title: Content and navigation do not depend on script
findings.where: Whole page (single-page app, assets/index-DG_D8YJA.js), all widths
findings.evidence: With scripts off the page has 0 visible and 0 total characters against 4,556 in the baseline (scripts_off_note 'no text at all with scripts off'). With an observer that never fires only 1,822 characters (40%) are visible. The sweep's hidden_content detector records both as ROB-001 Floors.
findings.before: A client-rendered page whose feature sections also wait on IntersectionObserver to appear.
findings.after: Prerender the landing page to static HTML and start the reveal animations from visible content, with a no-script safety class (draft ROB-204).
findings.why: A visitor or crawler without script sees nothing, and one whose observer never fires loses the feature grid and the installation guide.

findings.title: Weight fits the page's job
findings.where: Screenshot gallery thumbnails (image-search.png, vision.png, host-setup.png, reminder-popup.png, welcome.png), 1440px
findings.evidence: The gallery strip shows each screenshot at 124px wide while loading the 1,200px original (9.7 times oversize): image-search.png 299 KiB, vision.png 228 KiB, host-setup.png 136 KiB (performance.images.oversized_over_2.2x; sweep performance hits). Images total 982 KiB and the one script 486 KiB, so the page transfers 1,576 KiB (transfer and JS budgets warn). None of the 11 images is lazy-loaded (lazy_attr auto 11).
findings.before: Full-size PNG screenshots used as thumbnails, all loaded eagerly.
findings.after: Serve 248px WebP thumbnails with srcset, load the full screenshot only for the selected slide, and lazy-load every image below the hero (drafts ROB-166, ROB-167).
findings.why: A phone visitor downloads about 1 MB of screenshots at full size to see a strip of small thumbnails.
findings.root: No thumbnail sizes in the image pipeline

strengths: Feature cards and the 'How it works' steps stack one per row at 375 and let titles and long descriptions wrap (tiles/375-02.png to tiles/375-09.png); the document width equals the viewport at every width.
The stylesheet uses 5 container queries, 66 logical properties against 94 physical, and dvh or svh heights, so components adapt to their box rather than only to the viewport.
The lab LCP is 888 ms over 12 requests.
not_investigated: T-STRESS: no hostile content was injected; long names were judged from layout evidence.

A right-to-left render and translated strings were not captured. The installation-guide tabs ('Mac Host', 'Mac Client', 'Windows', 'Linux') fill their row with 0px free at every width; on this English-only page that is a readiness note, not a finding.
The page load was not throttled and layout shift was not measured as a number (capture predates the CLS record).
T-FAILURE-PATH and T-SLOW-LINE: async found no primary actions; the download buttons and the gallery were not exercised.
T-EXTREME-COUNTS: no counts or lists take user data on this page.
The 375 tiles stop at tiles/375-11.png, so the end of the installation guide and the footer at 375 were not seen.
One stylesheet was cross-origin and unreadable; its rules are unknown, not absent.
Widths between the captures, landscape, zoom at 200%, back navigation and deep links.
